mintAuthority.summary: GHO minting depends on DAO-approved facilitator contracts and bucket capacity rather than unrestricted issuer minting.

sources.label: GHO verified token source and constructor

controls.label: Aave Ethereum ACL Admin executor
controls.capDescription: The Aave ACL Admin executor holds GHO's default-admin, facilitator-manager, and bucket-manager roles and can authorize facilitators or raise their bucket capacities.
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 26095800, hasRole() returned true for this executor under DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE, FACILITATOR_MANAGER_ROLE, and BUCKET_MANAGER_ROLE. getFacilitatorsList() returned eight facilitator contracts.

controls.label: GHO Bucket Steward
controls.capDescription: Holds GHO BUCKET_MANAGER_ROLE. The verified steward permits only Risk Council increases for controlled facilitators, with each increase no greater than the current capacity and a one-day debounce between updates. The DAO executor controls the approved facilitator list. The debounce is not an execution timelock.
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 26095800, canonical GHO hasRole(BUCKET_MANAGER_ROLE, steward) returned true and hasRole(FACILITATOR_MANAGER_ROLE, steward) returned false. The steward's bytecode matched its verified source, GHO_TOKEN() returned canonical GHO, owner() returned 0x5300a1a15135ea4dc7ad5a167152c01efc9b192a, and RISK_COUNCIL() returned 0x8513e6f37dbc52de87b166980fa3f50639694b60. getControlledFacilitators() returned Core, Horizon, mainnet GSM and Lido facilitators; MINIMUM_DELAY() returned 86400.

sources.label: Verified GhoToken source matched to Ethereum block 26095800

review.evidence: At Ethereum block 26095800 (2026-10-01), canonical GHO bytecode matched the verified GhoToken deployment and its EIP-1967 implementation and correct admin slots were zero. The ACL Admin executor retained DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE, FACILITATOR_MANAGER_ROLE, and BUCKET_MANAGER_ROLE. getFacilitatorsList() returned eight registered facilitators and totalSupply() returned 699,000,000 GHO; the Arbitrum and Monad GSM facilitators each had 50,000,000 GHO capacity and level. The token's verified mint function enforces each facilitator's bucket capacity, while DAO-authorized administration can add facilitators or raise capacities. The separately verified GHO Bucket Steward also holds BUCKET_MANAGER_ROLE and can increase approved native facilitator capacities under its own Risk Council and debounce checks. Contract-governed issuance has no off-chain reserve reconciliation requirement; no prudential supervision of this native mint boundary is evidenced in the reviewed protocol disclosures.
